takucash.title: TAKU-Cash
takucash.description: TAKU-Cash was created after identifying the difficulties many people in Costa Rica face when organizing and understanding their personal finances. The platform provides a simple, accessible, and easy-to-use tool that helps anyone in the country manage their money more effectively and make better-informed financial decisions.
takucash.problem: Many people in Costa Rica struggle to organize their personal finances, especially when they need to manage multiple currencies, understand exchange rates, and analyze their expenses. The lack of simple tools adapted to this reality can make financial tracking confusing and difficult to maintain.
takucash.solution: An accessible financial system was developed to manage multiple currencies and exchange rates, generate easy-to-understand reports, and organize transactions through categories and subcategories. The application includes modern date pickers, a growth-ready hexagonal architecture, and approximately 200 unit and integration tests to validate its behavior. It also includes comprehensive documentation, administrator tools to simplify internal support, and monitoring through Sentry and Vercel Analytics, providing continuous visibility into the platform's health, performance, and usage.

livestock-pro.title: LivestockPro
livestock-pro.description: Livestock management system designed for inventory control and monetary transaction recording. The platform allows users to efficiently manage information about their livestock, breeds, farms, and transactions.
livestock-pro.problem: The project arose from the need for a system that would allow the user to keep detailed control of their inventory and monetary transactions. Before LivestockPro, the user faced difficulties maintaining accurate livestock records, which hindered the traceability required today in the Costa Rican livestock sector. Additionally, they wanted to know how much money each farm generates or spends in order to assess its profitability and make informed business decisions.
livestock-pro.solution: A web system was developed that allows the user to register, update, and delete information about their livestock, breeds, farms, and monetary transactions. The platform offers an intuitive and easy-to-use interface that allows users to access information quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the system generates detailed reports on inventory and transactions, facilitating informed decision-making about the livestock business.

post-destete.title: Post-Destete
post-destete.description: Post-weaning swine mortality management system designed to monitor causes of death and optimize production. The platform enables analyzing mortality patterns on the farm and taking data-driven preventive actions.
post-destete.problem: The project arose from the lack of mortality control on a swine farm, where no adequate record of death causes was kept. This generated little understanding of mortality patterns and hindered decision-making to improve production. As a result, the farm owner suffered economic losses and low productive efficiency, not knowing which diseases to prioritize, whether to make infrastructure improvements, or better train their staff.
post-destete.solution: A web system was developed for comprehensive mortality data and report management. The platform allows registering, updating, and deleting diseases, providing full control over the pathologies affecting post-weaning pigs. Additionally, the system records deceased animals with the following details: cause of death (disease), pen (cuna, corral, or hospital), death shift (morning, afternoon, or night), feed type, exact date, and animal weight. With this information, mortality reports are generated filtered by disease, pen, shift, feed, and weight, as well as reports by date to monitor mortality trends over time and facilitate informed decision-making.

tenis-fresonas.title: TenisFresonas
tenis-fresonas.description: Virtual catalog of sports products. Built to allow the admin user to manage their own catalog and the end user to view products quickly and easily. The platform enables users to efficiently manage information about their products, categories, and images.
tenis-fresonas.problem: The project arose from the need for a system that would allow Tenis Fresonas store to showcase their products in a virtual store in a simple way for their customers. Previously, they managed everything by sending thousands of photos daily to all their customers via WhatsApp or through a shared Google Drive, which was far from optimal for the end-user experience.
tenis-fresonas.solution: A web system was developed that allows the admin user to register and delete product information such as name, price, product type, brand, and image. Additionally, technologies were applied to optimize image loading as fast as possible, avoiding high bandwidth usage without losing image quality. The platform offers an intuitive and easy-to-use interface that allows users to access information quickly and efficiently. This enabled the end user (customer) to view products quickly and easily without long page load times.

ganado.title: Ganado
ganado.imageAlt: Screenshots of the Ganado web app
ganado.description: Progressive web app (PWA) to manage livestock quickly, from anywhere on the farm and without an internet connection. It lets you record each animal with its ear tag code, breed, sex, birth date, status, farm, and notes, and check its information instantly.
ganado.problem: The user had a gap with the new Trazaragro system: they needed to check their livestock data faster, from any point on their farms, even where there is no internet signal.
ganado.solution: A PWA was developed that installs on the phone like an app. All data is stored in the device's local storage, and the service worker lets the app open without a connection. This saves a lot of time, since the user doesn't need internet to quickly see information about their livestock.

huevos-chiquiticos.title: Huevos ChiquiTicos
huevos-chiquiticos.imageAlt: Screenshots of the Huevos ChiquiTicos management system
huevos-chiquiticos.description: Management system for a quail farming business. It centralizes production and accounting in one place: egg collection by cage, medications applied, mortality, bird entries and exits, plus customers, suppliers, orders, and accounts receivable and payable invoices. It includes dashboards with reports and works as a PWA so it can be used comfortably from a phone.
huevos-chiquiticos.problem: The client started a quail farming business and needed a system to monitor the entire production area: how many eggs are collected per cage, the medications applied, cage mortality, and bird entries and exits. They also needed to manage all their accounting —customers, suppliers, orders, and accounts receivable and payable invoices— and see it summarized in a single report, instead of tracking each area separately.
huevos-chiquiticos.solution: A web application was developed with production and accounting dashboards that bring the whole operation together in one place. The production module records cages, egg collections, medications, mortality, and bird movements; the accounting module manages customers, suppliers, orders, and accounts receivable and payable invoices. Access is protected with authentication and two-step verification, data is stored in PostgreSQL (Neon), and the app can be installed as a PWA to use it comfortably from a phone.

quizy.title: Quizy
quizy.description: Web platform for the comprehensive management of an academic institution. Quizy centralizes the administration of users, students, subjects, groups, exams, and questions, and includes a student portal for taking and reviewing assessments. The project was developed during a four-month university professional internship.
quizy.problem: The institution needed a centralized platform to organize its academic processes and manage student assessments from a single system.
quizy.solution: A modern, mobile-first platform was implemented to manage the institution's academic operations. Staff can manage users, students, subjects, groups, exams, and questions, while students have access to a portal for taking exams and reviewing their results. The solution includes data persistence, credential recovery, and an exam review workflow through email. In addition, approximately 135 automated tests were developed to validate the core logic and maintain system stability.
